d: Mid-length, vivid emerald-green hair with long bangs and a single prominent cowlick, framing a youthful, teenage face with large, sparkling emerald-green eyes. The slender build is dressed in a khaki short-sleeved military blouse over a white sailor-style collar, featuring a large light-green bow at the chest and a pleated white mini-skirt. A dark charcoal armored bodice with silver anchor detailing is worn over the torso, complemented by a red scarf tied around the neck and a matching red fabric drape at the hip. Black fingerless gloves cover the hands, while a large mechanical naval artillery rig is attached to the back.
